contentText:
Lenin Ramirez’s “Todo Lo Fue” reenters the top 10 of Hot Latin Songs, but can he take No. 1 from Bad Bunny?

Narrator: Here’s the Billboard Hot Latin Songs top 10 for the week dated July 4! Lenin Ramírez is back at No. 10. “De Lejitos” stays at nine. “Koko” climbs to eight. Peso Pluma and Tito Double P return to seven. And Los Dos de Tamaulipas’ “Ayúdame” lifts to six. “Voy a Llevarte Pa PR” rebounds to five. “Eoo” holds firm at four. “Nuevayol” keeps going at three. “Baile Inolvidable” remains strong at No. 2. And “DTMF” adds a 66th week at No. 1.
